payload.text: I read this as a focused implementation fix - I’ll inspect the existing DnD components, design-system patterns, and RED tests, then make the smallest production changes and run the required suites.

I read this as a focused production fix - implemented the existing RED-test requirements and verified the affected DnD paths.

Implemented:

- `SplitEdgeDropZone`
  - Retains the existing 20% droppable geometry.
  - Renders a separate sibling preview with:
    - `data-testid="split-edge-preview"`
    - `data-split-edge-preview="true"`
    - `data-preview-edge`
  - Preview spans exactly 50% of the pane/group parent.
  - Preview is `pointer-events-none`, absolute, and no longer clipped by the hit strip.
  - Preserves the `New split` label.
- `TabGroupDropSurface`
  - Group edges now reuse `SplitEdgeDropZone`.
- `TerminalSplitView`
  - Tracks valid workspace drags in React state.
  - Passes `visible={false}` to every rendered `BrowserPane` during valid tab/pane drags.
  - Restores visibility on drag end and cancellation.
  - Invalid drag data does not hide browser webviews.
- Drop resolver/store behavior was unchanged.

Changed files:

- `ui/src/components/TerminalSplitView.tsx`
- `ui/src/components/tab-dnd/TabGroupDropSurface.tsx`
- `ui/src/components/tab-dnd/SplitEdgeDropZone.tsx`
